title: Runtimes
description: GET /v2/runtimes (capability runtimes-view): native version registry entries and Claude runtimes with the agents pinned to each. Paths are reduced to directory / file names.

cutexBuild.description: Build identity of the cutex binary (same as /v2/capabilities cutexBuild). release / commit / builtAt are null on builds that did not set CUTEX_RELEASE / CUTEX_COMMIT / CUTEX_BUILD_TIME (dev builds).

version.description: Cargo package version (not a release id).

channel.description: Release channel the binary was built for: release (public / colleague builds, CUTEX_CHANNEL=release or the older stable) or main (default, owner / dev builds). Older daemons sent dev / stable.

entry.description: native: one registry version (release r50, version 0.160.0-r50) or an unregistered pinned executable (no version); claude: one runtime directory (release claude-r5).

path.description: <release dir>/<file> (native) or the adapter directory name (claude).

missing.description: The recorded files no longer exist.

release.description: Label of the directory the executable runs from (build.release is the label it was built as).

unpinnedAgentCount.description: Non-retired host agents without an explicit-launch pin (they launch on the selected package).
